title: In the Brooding Wild
summary: "In the Brooding Wild" by Ridgwell Cullum is a novel written in the early 20th century. Following this encounter, the brothers become captivated by Gagnon's tale of the enigmatic White Squaw, igniting a spectrum of emotions and setting them on a path of unexpected exploration.
